sourceDocuments.title: Sovereign Debt Sustainability in Emerging African Economies
sourceDocuments.text: External debt servicing consumes an unsustainable proportion of federally collected revenue, crowding out capital expenditure in public infrastructure and human capital development.

studentDocument.title: Microfinance Institutions and Small Business Credit in Ibadan
studentDocument.text: Community microcredit schemes provide working capital to informal market women cooperatives in Oyo State. High interest rates charged by informal moneylenders reinforce poverty cycles, whereas peer-monitored group borrowing models achieve high loan recovery rates without collateral requirements.
